 THE SECURITY DILEMMA
Under internationnal anarchy, states seek to accumulate power as a means to secure their survival. Yet, as a one state becomes stronger, others perceive its actions as a potential threat and repond by increasing their own power. This dynamic creats what scholars refer to as “the security dilemma”- a condition in which efforts to enhance security paradoxically produce greater insecurity.
